content: As of my last update in October 2023, the tallest building in the world is the Burj Khalifa, located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The Burj Khalifa stands at approximately 828 meters (2,717 feet) tall and has 163 floors. It has held the title of the world's tallest building since its completion in 2010. However, building records can change, so it's always a good idea to check the latest information from reliable sources.
